name: piper
description: Context compression algorithm (TS + mini-swe-agent bridge) and SWE-bench evaluation harness

scripts.bench:apps:pair: tsx src/harness/benchmark-cli.ts run --tasks artifacts/apps-baseline-search/selected.tasks.jsonl --agent command --cmd npx --cmd-arg tsx --cmd-arg src/apps-agent.ts --model gpt-5.4-mini --summarizer-model gpt-4.1-mini --max-context-tokens 3500 --out artifacts/apps-long-pair
scripts.bench:demo: tsx src/harness/benchmark-cli.ts run --tasks data/sample-benchmark-tasks.jsonl --agent mock --out artifacts/benchmark-demo
scripts.bench:mini:dev1: tsx src/harness/benchmark-cli.ts run --tasks data/swebench-lite-dev1.tasks.jsonl --agent mini-swe-agent --python python --max-context-tokens 6000 --out artifacts/mini-swebench-dev1
scripts.bench:mini:dev4: tsx src/harness/benchmark-cli.ts run --tasks data/swebench-lite-dev4.tasks.jsonl --agent mini-swe-agent --python python --out artifacts/mini-swebench-dev4
scripts.bench:mini:dev4:docker: tsx src/harness/benchmark-cli.ts run --tasks data/swebench-lite-dev4-docker.tasks.jsonl --agent mini-swe-agent --python python --out artifacts/mini-swebench-dev4-docker
